law.title: Required position and method of turning at intersections (2)(b)
law.text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: After entering the intersection, the left turn must be made so as to leave the intersection to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered.
